scenarios.title_zh: 机器人配送时间窗压力测试
scenarios.privacy_boundary: No face recognition or individual trajectory profiling is required.
scenarios.human_review: Mobility safety officer approves the test window.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Human delivery and manual service access remain available.
scenarios.validation: Replay conflict logs and verify all P0 routes remain continuous.

scenarios.title_zh: 低速自动接驳冲突降级测试
scenarios.title_en: Low-speed Shuttle Conflict and Degradation Test
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Only operational telemetry needed for safety and audit is retained.
scenarios.human_review: Named safety officer confirms start and can terminate at any time.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Conventional accessible shuttle or walking route remains open.
scenarios.validation: Demonstrate safe stop, downgrade and manual takeover in controlled trials.

scenarios.title_zh: 人群高峰自动退出测试
scenarios.typical_window: triggered by declared crowding state rather than a fixed clock time
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Aggregate density classes only; no identity tracking.
scenarios.human_review: Duty manager verifies the downgrade and reopening decision.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Robots/shuttles exit; public walking and staffed service continue.
scenarios.validation: Check that lower-priority machine uses vacate before P0/P1 rights are affected.

scenarios.privacy_boundary: Audit operational decisions, not personal identities of passers-by.
scenarios.human_review: Named responsible operator owns every override.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Manual operation procedure and physical stop control.
scenarios.validation: Randomly sample logs and reproduce the state transition from request to rollback.

scenarios.title_zh: 青年 Demo Night 可逆公共客厅
scenarios.title_en: Youth Demo Night Reversible Public Living Room
scenarios.privacy_boundary: No mandatory app login or behavioural profiling for entry.
scenarios.human_review: Event responsible person confirms setup/open/close and resident-access protection.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Static signage, staffed information and ordinary public route remain available.
scenarios.validation: Before/after checklist verifies full reversibility and restoration of normal use.

scenarios.title_zh: 免 App 公共服务导航
scenarios.privacy_boundary: No account, face scan or personal profile required for basic navigation.
scenarios.human_review: Service operator periodically verifies content accuracy and accessibility.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Printed map, conventional wayfinding and staffed help desk.
scenarios.validation: Mystery-user test confirms equivalent completion without phone or account.

scenarios.title_zh: AI 文化导览与非数字等价路线
scenarios.title_en: AI Cultural Guide with Non-digital Equivalent Route
scenarios.privacy_boundary: No identity inference; cultural content must use cleared or public sources.
scenarios.human_review: Content editor verifies historical accuracy and copyright status.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Physical signs, printed route and ordinary wayfinding carry equivalent core content.
scenarios.validation: Compare AI and non-AI versions for equivalent essential narrative and access.

scenarios.title_zh: 夜间学习与轻运动空间切换
scenarios.title_en: Night Learning and Light-sport Space Switch
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Bookings may use minimum necessary contact data; anonymous walk-in capacity remains where feasible.
scenarios.human_review: Community duty manager confirms daily mode switch.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Manual booking board and ordinary seating/open-space use.
scenarios.validation: Weekly audit of switch success, complaints and restoration time.

scenarios.privacy_boundary: Publish rules and capacity; do not publish confidential applicant material.
scenarios.human_review: Relevant space/safety owner accepts or rejects the request.
scenarios.validation: Every approval can be traced to requirements, owner and schedule slot.

scenarios.title_zh: 企业 Demo 时段共享
scenarios.privacy_boundary: No exclusive profiling of visitors; public events disclose data collection if any.
scenarios.human_review: Venue operator confirms safety, clearance and equitable scheduling.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Conventional exhibition scheduling and staffed venue management.
scenarios.validation: Audit slot allocation, reset time and public-space continuity.

scenarios.privacy_boundary: Use operational counts and schedules; individual tracking is not required.
scenarios.human_review: Event command role confirms final timetable and incident changes.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Printed operating plan, radio/phone coordination and staffed control points.
scenarios.validation: Run pre-event conflict simulation plus post-event log reconciliation.

scenarios.typical_window: continuous public display with timestamped updates
scenarios.privacy_boundary: Display operational state, never personal movement histories.
scenarios.human_review: Duty owner verifies exceptions and incident notes.
scenarios.non_ai_fallback: Static boards and staffed information points provide current essential changes.
scenarios.validation: Public audit sample compares displayed state with operator log.
